questions.question: What grammatical role does a noun take when it follows وَاوُ الْمَعِيَّة?
options: It mirrors the i'raab of the preceding noun as Ma'toof
It becomes منصوب as مَفْعُولٌ مَعَهُ
It becomes مرفوع as Fa'il
It becomes مجرور in place of a Mudaaf
questions.explanation: A noun following وَاوُ الْمَعِيَّة is منصوب and is called مَفْعُولٌ مَعَهُ, indicating that the Fa'il and this noun co-occurred.

questions.question: In the sentence جِئْتُ وَزَيْدًا, why is Nasb obligatory for زَيْدًا?
options: The Ma'toof 'Alayh is a ضَمِيرٌ مُتَّصِل with no ضَمِيرٌ مُنْفَصِل present
زَيْد is a proper noun and proper nouns are always منصوب
The Fa'il is absent and cannot take a conjunction
The verb جَاءَ cannot take a Ma'toof after it
questions.explanation: نَصْبٌ مُتَعَيَّن applies here because the Ma'toof 'Alayh (تُ) is a ضَمِيرٌ مُتَّصِل with no ضَمِيرٌ مُنْفَصِل, making 'Atf impermissible.

questions.question: What does inserting أَنَا into the sentence جِئْتُ أَنَا وَزَيْدٌ/زَيْدًا accomplish?
options: It restores the permissibility of 'Atf, giving two valid grammatical options
It converts the وَاو into a حَرْفُ عَطْف
It removes زَيْد from the sentence's grammatical structure
It makes Nasb the only valid grammatical option for زَيْد
questions.explanation: Inserting أَنَا (a ضَمِيرٌ مُنْفَصِل) restores the permissibility of 'Atf, so زَيْد can validly be either منصوب (Maf'ool Ma'ahu) or مرفوع (Ma'toof).

questions.question: How does a مَعْطُوف determine its own i'raab?
options: It is always منصوب regardless of the i'raab of its Ma'toof 'Alayh
It is always مرفوع when conjoined to a مرفوع or منصوب noun
It takes its i'raab independently based on its function in the sentence
It always mirrors the i'raab of its مَعْطُوفٌ عَلَيْه
questions.explanation: A مَعْطُوف has no independent i'raab — it always follows its مَعْطُوفٌ عَلَيْه in being مرفوع, منصوب, or مجرور.

questions.question: What does مُصَاحَبَة mean in the context of مَفْعُولٌ مَعَهُ?
options: Companionship; the co-occurrence of the Fa'il and another noun
The obligation of Nasb when 'Atf is not permissible
The role of a detached pronoun in permitting 'Atf
The mirroring of i'raab between Ma'toof and Ma'toof 'Alayh
questions.explanation: مُصَاحَبَة means companionship or co-occurrence — it describes the relationship مَفْعُولٌ مَعَهُ expresses, that the Fa'il and this noun acted together.

questions.question: What is وَاوُ الْمَعِيَّة?
options: A Waaw that introduces a conditional clause
A Waaw that makes what follows مجرور
The Waaw meaning 'along with,' making what follows منصوب as Maf'ool Ma'ahu
The Waaw meaning 'and,' making what follows take the i'raab of the Ma'toof 'Alayh
questions.explanation: وَاوُ الْمَعِيَّة means 'along with' and its object is منصوب as مَفْعُولٌ مَعَهُ, distinguishing it from حَرْفُ عَطْف which means 'and' and requires i'raab agreement.

questions.question: What is a ضَمِيرٌ مُنْفَصِل, and what role does it play in sentences with مَفْعُولٌ مَعَهُ?
options: A pronoun that always requires the noun after it to be مرفوع
A noun that becomes منصوب after وَاوُ الْمَعِيَّة
A detached pronoun (like أَنَا or أَنْتَ) that restores the permissibility of 'Atf when inserted beside a ضَمِيرٌ مُتَّصِل
An attached pronoun that blocks 'Atf when present as the Ma'toof 'Alayh
questions.explanation: A ضَمِيرٌ مُنْفَصِل is a detached pronoun such as أَنَا or أَنْتَ; inserting one beside a ضَمِيرٌ مُتَّصِل removes the block on 'Atf and makes both Nasb and Raf' valid options.

questions.question: What is the Ḥanafī ruling on praying nawāfil before Maghrib?
options: It is not permitted; the Maghrib farḍ must be prayed immediately
Four rakʿāt are permitted as a Sunnah Muʾakkadah before Maghrib
Two rakʿāt are permitted, in agreement with the Shāfiʿī madhhab
It is مستحب to pray two rakʿāt, following transmitted practice
questions.explanation: In the Ḥanafī madhhab, nawāfil before Maghrib are not permitted and the farḍ must be prayed immediately, unlike Imām al-Shāfiʿī who permits two rakʿāt based on a ḥadīth in Bukhārī.

questions.question: Which combination correctly lists the 12 daily Sunnah Muʾakkadah rakʿāt?
options: 2 Fajr + 4 Ẓuhr + 2 ʿAṣr + 4 ʿIshāʾ
4 Fajr + 4 Ẓuhr + 2 Maghrib + 2 ʿIshāʾ
2 Fajr + 4 before and 2 after Ẓuhr + 2 Maghrib + 2 ʿIshāʾ
2 Fajr + 2 Ẓuhr + 4 ʿAṣr + 2 Maghrib + 2 ʿIshāʾ
questions.explanation: The 12 Sunnah Muʾakkadah rakʿāt are: 2 before Fajr, 4 before and 2 after Ẓuhr, 2 after Maghrib, and 2 after ʿIshāʾ — and a ḥadīth promises a house in Jannah for observing them.

questions.question: What is the ruling on the 4 rakʿāt sunnah before ʿAṣr in the Ḥanafī madhhab?
options: Sunnah Muʾakkadah — habitually missing it is blameworthy
Farḍ — obligatory alongside the ʿAṣr prayer
مستحب — recommended but no sin for omission
Not permitted — no nawāfil may be prayed before ʿAṣr
questions.explanation: The 4 rakʿāt before ʿAṣr are مستحب (recommended), not Sunnah Muʾakkadah, so missing them carries no blame — unlike the 12 emphasized sunnahs.

questions.question: According to Imām Abū Ḥanīfah, how many rakʿāt may be prayed in a single salām during night nawāfil?
options: Up to 12 rakʿāt per salām
Up to 8 rakʿāt per salām
Only 2 rakʿāt per salām, the same as the Ṣāḥibayn hold
Up to 4 rakʿāt per salām
questions.explanation: Imām Abū Ḥanīfah permits up to 8 rakʿāt per salām at night, while the Ṣāḥibayn and Imām al-Shāfiʿī restrict night nawāfil to 2 rakʿāt per salām.

questions.question: What does مستحب mean in Islamic legal terminology?
options: Obligatory; one is sinful for omission
An emphasized sunnah the Prophet ﷺ was rarely absent from
Voluntary night prayer performed after sleeping
Recommended; rewarding but no sin for omission
questions.explanation: مستحب denotes a recommended act that earns reward when performed but carries no blame for omission, making it a lesser grade than Sunnah Muʾakkadah.

questions.question: What is تَهَجُّد?
options: An emphasized sunnah the Prophet ﷺ rarely missed
Supplications transmitted from the Prophet ﷺ
Six voluntary rakʿāt after the Maghrib farḍ
Voluntary night prayer performed after sleeping
questions.explanation: تَهَجُّد refers specifically to voluntary night prayer performed after sleeping, distinguishing it from night worship performed before sleeping.

questions.question: What are دُعَاءٌ مَأْثُورَة?
options: Supplications transmitted from the Prophet ﷺ
Six voluntary rakʿāt after the Maghrib farḍ
Personal needs held silently in the heart during ṣalāh
The best moments for duʿāʾ within ṣalāh
questions.explanation: دُعَاءٌ مَأْثُورَة are supplications that have been transmitted from the Prophet ﷺ; duʿāʾ in ṣalāh must be in Arabic drawn from these transmitted supplications.
